ranking_basis: risk-adjusted research value per implementation cost; planning priors only, not measurements

candidate_hypotheses.name: Cross-band radiometric edge coherence as a weak third D-S source
candidate_hypotheses.signature: Masked Gaussian gradient magnitudes at sigma 1 and 3 pixels; per-band/scale P99 clipping; doubled-angle orientation coherence across the eight gradients.
candidate_hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Fault juxtaposition or hydrothermal alteration can create co-oriented radiometric edges where an unmapped fault lacks a catalogue trace; contacts and weathering are major confounders.
candidate_hypotheses.prior_art_difference: Not H50-B's low-Th/K level anomaly inside a B2xH36 conflict corridor. Uses all-band multiscale gradients/orientation coherence and a weak radiometric BPA in a B2xH33-D fusion.
candidate_hypotheses.expected_proxy_dti_effect: subjective prior near zero to small positive; broad plausible range -0.01 to +0.01; not empirically calibrated
candidate_hypotheses.data_obtainability: local GeoDAWN 4-band radiometry available; zero is nodata

candidate_hypotheses.name: USGS National Geochemical Survey pathfinder anomalies
layers: As/Sb/Hg and sample-method/media fields where available
candidate_hypotheses.signature: Quality-controlled robust multielement anomaly and spatial gradient, with drainage/media/method controls.
candidate_hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Hydrothermal fluids can redistribute pathfinders into sediment/soil above blind or unmapped structures; stream transport, mining, lithology, sparse data, and mixed methods confound the signal.
candidate_hypotheses.prior_art_difference: No geochemistry point model has been built in this repository; distinct from airborne radiometry, 2 m temperature probes, and lidar scarps.
candidate_hypotheses.expected_proxy_dti_effect: potentially moderate but unquantified and high variance
candidate_hypotheses.cost: medium-high; source harmonization, AOI coverage, sample media, and method QC required
candidate_hypotheses.data_obtainability: USGS page lists official download packages; exact AOI count and reuse terms not checked; no payload downloaded

candidate_hypotheses.name: GeoDAWN airborne magnetic analytic-signal/gradient ridges
layers: official GeoDAWN magnetic grid and metadata
candidate_hypotheses.signature: Directional horizontal-gradient or analytic-signal ridges and edge terminations at survey-compatible resolution.
candidate_hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Offset magnetized units can create linear gradients beneath cover where a fault is not in the catalogue; lithologic contacts and cultural noise confound.
candidate_hypotheses.prior_art_difference: Related H49 magnetic-texture proposal exists, but no analytic-signal/edge implementation or holdout receipt was found; not claimed as a new general concept.
candidate_hypotheses.cost: high; magnetic payload/coverage/resolution and reproducible acquisition not verified
candidate_hypotheses.data_obtainability: USGS GeoDAWN metadata list magnetic data; local mirror contains radiometry only
